1504369.ov: An emotional story of two brothers; the biography of Dr. Amarjit Singh, an Indian American immigrant who walked through The First Kashmir War as a child, forced from his home with his severely disabled brother and a family in fear for their lives.

1609201.ov: The film follows a powerful and cruel family whose oppression makes life unbearable for the villagers. After the family’s heir commits a grave crime, a woman places a curse on the household, setting in motion a chain of events that leads to the family’s complete downfall.
